verdict.line: You lose if you let extended, multi-exchange trades drag on until his passive and shield stack up; you win if you force quick E-into-W all-ins and never ult after he does.

brief.thesis: Illaoi's W (Harsh Lesson) and E (Test of Spirit) let her start and end a trade faster than Mordekaiser can stack Darkness Rise, which only triggers after three landed hits. The catch is ultimate order: if he lands R (Realm of Death) on you after you've already used your own R (Leap of Faith), every tentacle you spawned stays outside his Death Realm and does nothing, so the matchup swings hard on who commits R first.

theirWindow.when: Right after he lands E (Death's Grasp)
theirWindow.what: He's pulled you into range and started his passive count; expect a Q (Obliterate) and autos chasing Darkness Rise's third hit. Disengage before he completes it rather than trading through it.

yourWindow.when: While his E is still on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Step up and threaten E (Test of Spirit, range 900) from outside his 700-range Death's Grasp. If he can't pull you, follow with W (Harsh Lesson) to drag nearby tentacles onto him and stack the spirit echo damage.

start.why: The lane is won through short, repeated W/E all-ins rather than sustained poke exchanges, and Doran's Blade's lifesteal keeps you healthy through those trades (45.5% WR, 44% pick).

boots.why: Tenacity shortens how long his Death's Grasp pull and any CC chain keeps you locked down, and the MR blunts his Q/R magic damage (47.2% WR, 80% pick).

core.why: The armor shred and haste fuel faster Q/W/E resets, so you can land more all-in windows before his passive stabilizes a fight.
The slow on W (Harsh Lesson) engage keeps him inside tentacle range instead of kiting out, and the extra CDR tightens your E uptime.
Magic resist plus healing amp directly counters the W (Indestructible) shield-into-heal pattern and boosts your own tentacle sustain.

situational.when: you're getting bursted down mid-all-in and need a survivability buffer to finish the trade
his magic burst is ramping fast and you need a spell shield plus MR to survive his engage
you're already ahead and want more on-hit burst through his armor instead of raw tankiness

runes.keystoneWhy: Grasp rewards the repeated auto-trades your W/E all-in pattern creates and gives bonus health that lets you out-brawl his Q (Obliterate) poke instead of losing the war of attrition to his passive.

summoners.why: Exhaust is the highest win-rate pick here (62.5%) and directly answers the matchup's core problem: popping it the moment he opens Death's Grasp or Q blunts the passive-fueled burst that otherwise wins him extended trades. Flash covers the repositioning needed to land your E first or escape his R threat.

playing.title: Poke with E, don't facecheck his E
playing.detail: Use E (Test of Spirit, range 900) to threaten a vessel conversion from outside his Death's Grasp's 700 range. Only walk inside that range once his E is on cooldown.

playing.title: All-in the moment his E is down
playing.detail: Death's Grasp is 16s at rank 1 scaling to 8s at rank 5 — once it's spent, leap in with W (Harsh Lesson) to pull nearby tentacles onto him and stack the E spirit-echo damage.

playing.title: Never ult second
playing.detail: If he lands R (Realm of Death) after you've already used R (Leap of Faith), your tentacles are stuck outside the Death Realm and deal nothing. Only use R as your own engage opener, never as a reply to his.

playing.title: Track his third landed hit
playing.detail: Darkness Rise triggers after 3 attacks or spells connect, giving him a damage aura and move speed. Break off a trade before he lands that third hit, especially right after his Q plus autos.

playing.title: Bait his shield before you commit
playing.detail: Indestructible banks the damage he deals and takes into a heal. Poke it down with Q (Tentacle Smash) from range before you commit to a melee all-in, so your damage doesn't just refill his heal.

playing.title: Stop initiating past level 9
playing.detail: Once his W/passive sustain stabilizes mid-game fights, shift to poking with Q/E instead of full all-ins until you out-item him again.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win rates are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.20.1); the trade timing, cooldown reads, and ultimate-order reasoning are my own tactical analysis layered on top.

stats.opponentTip: Mordekaiser has the upper hand in prolonged fights due to his (W) and (P) even when your [E] lands successfully. Mordekaiser will always win if he uses his (R) after you use [R], as all of your tentacles will be outside the Death Realm. Never use your [R] before (R), and use your [E] to harass him without being hit by (E).
